It doesn't really seem like a base building game, I know, it says right there that you're building a prison, and you are, but it's a lot more about base building than anything else. You have to build buildings to house all of the prisoners, you have to keep them from harming each other, you have to keep them from escaping, you have to keep the place clean, and you have to make sure that the people who are in there don't re-offend when they get out. There's a surprising amount of meta in it which feels a lot more like base building than SpaceBase DF9 did. It's still currently in early access, but is supposed to be officially released in a few months. It's almost entirely feature complete at this time. I would highly suggest taking a look at the steam page, or look at any of the more recent lets plays of it.
